content.short: Token Tails is a cat-care Web3 game where players create portraits, earn TAILS, and support shelter cats.
content.description: Token Tails is built around digital cat care and charity. Players care for a cat, generate royal-style portraits, track achievements, earn TAILS, and contribute to shelter-cat support through game actions, making it more of a social pet game than a pure token page. Take care of your cat, create royal portraits, and help save real shelter cats with every action. Token Tails | Forever Feline Explore Shelter Impact Reviews FAQ Play Game Charity-driven · Every action helps shelter cats 4.9 · 10K+ cat parents Take care of your cat Immortalize your cat as art.
